name: Id & I
storyline:
Social life was becoming too stressful for Seralina, ever since her online friends disappeared.

In the hopes of getting away from it all, she decided she would move to a long-abandoned block called Risenshine. Nobody would ever bother her again.

...Right?
summary: id & i is a psychological horror visual novel that takes place in the Ad Nauseam (a VN also developed by throwpup) universe. However, it is a standalone experience that does not require you to have played Ad Nauseam first, nor will it spoil anything from the series.
